_header: The autopilot lane-queue contract, v1: the ONE place its names and thresholds are defined. Read by tooling/autopilot/issue-queue.mjs (and through it queue-migrate.mjs); docs/autopilot/queue.md describes it and tooling/ci/test/autopilot-queue-doc.test.mjs fails when the doc names a label or threshold this file does not hold. The queue's issues live in the PRIVATE repo; nothing here is lane content. ⏱ 2026-10-02 (club-rt-autopilot): the FAILOVER half — the laptop heartbeat, the reviewer and fixer claim staleness, the Public labels, the four cloud routines and the pipeline-driver switch — is the keys after `laptopRunner`, described in docs/autopilot/contract.md; tooling/ci/test/autopilot-contract.test.mjs fails on a tooling/autopilot/*.mjs that hard-codes a label or threshold held here. The heartbeat's STALE_MIN is `thresholds.HEARTBEAT_STALE_MIN`: one number, never two.
